load_mujoco_model_from_xml: load a MuJoCo physics model from an XML string or file path using load_model_from_xml
create_mjsim_and_step: create an MjSim simulation from a model and call reset, step, and forward to advance physics
get_and_set_sim_state: get the MjSimState from a simulation, flatten it, and restore it with set_state
query_body_joint_site_data: query body positions, joint qpos/qvel, and site jacobians using sim.data getter methods
raycast_simulation_geoms: cast rays through the simulation to detect geom intersections with sim.ray and exclusion options
